prompt: Drone mission: fly to the red tower and stop there. Return the point as relative coordinates on a 1000 by 1000 reference grid: u=0 is the left edge, u=999 the right edge, v=0 the top edge, and v=999 the bottom edge. Inspect this current camera image. In evidence use a short noun phrase describing the visible objects and colors. If the exact requested object is visible, set kind=target and point u,v on its visible body. Otherwise set kind=exploration and point u,v through an open passage that can reveal more of the scene. An obstacle face is not an open passage. Match all requested attributes; a similar shape alone is insufficient. The executor is continuing the previously accepted target goal during a bounded detour. The exploratory replacement was deferred, not judged blocked. Inspect this current image: report target only if it is currently identifiable. Return JSON with evidence, kind, u, v.
